verdict.rationale: Isaac ROS ships deployable ROS 2 packages for navigation and perception that run on embedded Jetson hardware, and GR00T is positioned for deploying AI-powered robots, so commanding real robots through the platform's SDK stack is plausible. However, the evidence never shows an agent-facing API with authentication or scoped credentials, and the OpenAPI probes returned 404. Most of the material concerns simulation rather than live robot control. Missing for 10: scoped credential and authentication model, a documented agent-facing API for real-robot command, an end-to-end real-robot control walkthrough, and independent corroboration.
